title: A master creates a repository and a hosting project through one scoped, logged route
description: Against a real control plane, a temporary Postgres and stand-ins for GitHub and Railway: the owner approves one repository and one hosting project; the master's credential creates and pushes that repository and creates that project and its environments, and is refused for any other name in one line; every call is listed with who, what and when on the Setup page and by graphyard infra log; guide infra names the route and forbids an unconfined session.

steps.name: Scoped infra access: approve, take, create, push, refuse, list
